name: @fmla/contracts
description: JSON Schema shapes for EvidenceField, Exception, EvidencePackage — generated to TypeScript here, and to pydantic for services/processor. CI fails on drift (see scripts/check-drift.sh).

scripts.generate: json2ts -i schema/evidence-field.schema.json -o generated/ts/evidence-field.d.ts --cwd schema --unreachableDefinitions && json2ts -i schema/exception.schema.json -o generated/ts/exception.d.ts --cwd schema --unreachableDefinitions && json2ts -i schema/evidence-package.schema.json -o generated/ts/evidence-package.d.ts --cwd schema --unreachableDefinitions
